snippet.title: Heroes of Anirea - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Heroes of Anirea is a hero-based tactical RPG with roguelite progression.

Assemble your squad from a diverse cast of heroes and evolve your approach as new challenges arise. Discover the world of Anirea, where elemental powers arise almost everywhere. Recruit and command over 20 unique heroes from Anirea. Each hero comes with a distinctive skill set and a personal story waiting to be uncovered.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783410/Heroes_of_Anirea?utm_source=youtube

© 2025 Heroes of Anirea, a game by Crossbros
